project.name: SARA
project.track: Physical AI for Resilience and Inclusion
project.headline: Goes in first, so people don't have to.
project.oneLiner: A small, low-cost snake robot that crawls into rubble gaps first, so rescuers get camera, heat, CO2 and sound evidence before anyone goes in.
project.renderCredit: All renders made by the team

petg.name: Brushed Aluminium 6061 (Outer Shell)
petg.reason: Machined aluminium outer body shells and structural belt frames resist crushing rubble impacts while dissipating electronics heat.

tpu.name: TPU 95A (3D Printed)
tpu.reason: Soft and grippy vulcanized-style elastomer for rubble traction belts, nose bumper, and pleated joint boots.

al6061.name: Aluminium 6061-T6 (CNC Machined)
al6061.reason: CNC-machined brushed alloy for outer body clamshells, belt chassis, cardan yokes, and rear retrieval anchor.

steel.name: Steel (Dark Machined)
steel.reason: High wear strength where joint crosses pivot, bearings roll, and pull cables route.

heartbeat.name: Concept Enclosure (Future Patent-Track)
heartbeat.reason: Highlighted in cyan to distinguish future post-competition vital-sign concept.

parts.name: Head Clamshell Housing (Aluminium)
parts.mass: Part of 107 g head assembly (CAD estimate)
parts.dimensions: 120 mm length (placeholder, replace from CAD), 84 mm dia
parts.description: Two-piece CNC-machined brushed aluminium split housing enclosing the Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W and head sensor suite, with recessed M2.5 stainless bolts and cooling/inspection slots.

parts.name: Orange TPU Nose Cap & Vent Grille
parts.dimensions: 84 mm outer dia, tapered dome with vent holes
parts.description: Impact-absorbing soft bumper on the leading end. Holds optical windows for RGB and thermal cameras, 4 white LEDs, and airflow vent holes for the CO2 sensor.

parts.name: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W
parts.mass: To be measured on the bench
parts.dimensions: 65 × 30 mm (standard board)
parts.description: Streams live video and sensor data up to the operator laptop over the tether and talks to the tail ESP32 over UART. AI runs on the laptop because the Pi Zero 2 W is too small.

parts.name: OV5647 RGB Camera (CSI)
parts.mass: To be measured on the bench
parts.dimensions: 25 × 24 mm module
parts.description: Forward-facing visible-light camera connected to the Pi CSI ribbon port so operators can inspect dark rubble pockets illuminated by the nose LEDs.

parts.name: MLX90640 Thermal Camera (I2C)
parts.mass: To be measured on the bench
parts.dimensions: I2C address 0x33, 3.3 V logic
parts.description: Detects body heat signatures in complete darkness or heavy dust where normal cameras struggle.

parts.name: MH-Z19B CO2 Sensor (PWM)
parts.mass: To be measured on the bench
parts.dimensions: 33 × 20 × 9 mm module
parts.description: Measures elevated carbon dioxide concentration behind the nose vent holes as secondary evidence of human breathing in confined cavities.

parts.name: INMP441 Digital Microphone (I2S)
parts.mass: To be measured on the bench
parts.dimensions: 14 mm dia breakout
parts.description: Captures faint voices, knocking, or breathing sounds inside rubble voids via I2S digital audio to the Pi Zero 2 W.

parts.name: 4× Nose LEDs + MOSFET Driver
parts.mass: To be measured on the bench
parts.dimensions: 4× 5 mm LEDs, 100 Ω resistors, 5 V rail (~0.08 A)
parts.description: Lights up dark gaps ahead of the camera and blinks automatically as a visual warning if the ESP32 watchdog trips.

parts.name: Heartbeat (Vital Sign) Sensor Module
parts.dimensions: Sensor type, range and accuracy: to be decided and tested
parts.source: Concept only — not in current BOM
parts.description: CONCEPT, not in current build. Future non-contact sensor planned after the competition to detect a human heartbeat from a distance so rescuers can prioritise confirmed living survivors. Absence of a reading is always shown as 'NO VITAL SIGN DETECTED, UNCONFIRMED' — never 'dead'.

parts.name: Machined Aluminium 6061 Cardan Yokes (×8)
parts.dimensions: 2 yokes per joint across 4 joints (45 mm joint length placeholder)
parts.description: Two orthogonal aluminium clevis yokes form each universal joint, delivering high bending stiffness at the pivot points without excess weight. FEA planned next.

parts.name: Steel Cross & 16 Small Bearings
parts.dimensions: 1 steel cross + 4 small bearings per joint (16 bearings total)
parts.description: Allows smooth 2-axis pitch and yaw articulation under cable tension while resisting torsional twisting as the belt modules push through rubble.

parts.name: TPU 95A Flexible Joint Sleeves (×4)
parts.dimensions: 45 mm length (placeholder, replace from CAD), ~84 mm outer dia
parts.description: Soft elastomeric shroud covering each cardan joint to deflect loose gravel and dust while flexing freely during bends. Note: body is not sealed (no IP rating).

parts.name: 4 Steel Control Cables per Joint
parts.dimensions: 4 cables per joint routed axially to tail servos
parts.description: Four cables run in orthogonal quadrants from the tail MG90S servos to each cardan joint. Pulling one side bends the joint in that direction; 4 cables share load for redundancy.

parts.name: Belt Module Aluminium Chassis & Drums (×3)
parts.dimensions: 96 mm length (placeholder, replace from CAD), 84 mm inner frame
parts.description: Open-frame CNC-machined aluminium chassis holding 4 orthogonal belt tracks, toothed drive rollers, and 4 exposed N20 gear motor mounts around the 12 mm central wiring tunnel.

parts.name: Treaded TPU 95A Drive Belts (×12)
parts.mass: Part of 142 g per belt module
parts.dimensions: 4 belts per module (top, bottom, left, right), 101 × 101 mm outer span
parts.description: All-around traction tracks ensure SARA keeps moving even if it rolls sideways or presses against overhead rubble inside tight cavities.

parts.name: 12× N20 Metal-Gear Motors
parts.material: Steel motor can, brass spur gearbox & steel D-shaft
parts.mass: Part of 142 g per belt module
parts.dimensions: 4 per belt module; 12 V-rated run on 7.4 V rail (~0.1–0.2 A moving)
parts.description: Compact brass-gearbox DC motors seated directly in each aluminium module bay, driving all 12 toothed belt rollers via 6 TB6612FNG dual drivers. Running 12 V motors on 7.4 V lowers speed and torque — bench test planned in Dec 2026.

parts.name: Internal Wiring Harness & Rear Tether
parts.material: Silicone-insulated multi-conductor loom, FFC ribbon & JST leads
parts.dimensions: 12 mm core tunnel: 5 V/GND, UART, CO2 PWM, 24 N20 motor wires, 8 servo leads + tether
parts.description: Color-coded silicone wire bundle routed through every cardan joint bore from Head Pi & sensors to Tail ESP32, 6 TB6612FNG drivers, and 8 MG90S servos, plus rear USB-Ethernet tether (Stage 3 TBD).

parts.name: Tail Bay Clamshell Housing (Aluminium)
parts.mass: Part of 351 g tail bay (heaviest segment)
parts.dimensions: 119 mm length (placeholder, replace from CAD), 84 mm dia
parts.description: Machined brushed aluminium split shell enclosing the 2S Li-ion battery pack, ESP32 watchdog, 8 cable servos, and all 6 motor drivers, with rear bulkhead grommet for the tether and M6 retrieval eyebolt.

parts.name: ESP32 DevKit + 2× MCP23017 Expanders
parts.dimensions: 12 motor PWMs, I2C, UART2, MOTOR_EN watchdog, 2× NTC ADC
parts.description: Runs low-level motion control and the independent safety watchdog. If commands go quiet for ~0.5 s, ESP32 cuts MOTOR_EN even if the Pi Zero 2 W hangs.

parts.name: 8× MG90S Servos + PCA9685 Driver
parts.material: Metal-gear micro servos & I2C PWM PCB
parts.dimensions: 6 V rail (5 A buck); worst-case all-stall ~5.6 A
parts.description: Pulls the steel joint tendons to steer SARA's 4 cardan joints. Firmware limits simultaneous servo motion to stay inside the 5 A buck converter budget.

parts.name: 6× TB6612FNG Dual Motor Drivers
parts.dimensions: 12 independent belt outputs, thermal shutdown built in
parts.description: Drives all 12 N20 belt motors from the 7.4 V rail using 12 ESP32 PWM pins and 24 direction pins from the two MCP23017 I/O expanders.

parts.name: 2× 18650 Battery Pack + BMS + Dual Bucks
parts.material: 2S Li-ion cells, 2S BMS, 10 A fuse, 5 V 3 A & 6 V 5 A bucks
parts.mass: Major share of 351 g tail bay
parts.dimensions: 7.4 V nominal (6.0–8.4 V), 2× NTC temperature probes
parts.description: Supplies 7.4 V to belt motors, regulated 5 V (3 A) to compute/sensors, and regulated 6 V (5 A) to steering servos, protected by a 2S BMS, 10 A fuse, and main switch.

parts.name: Aluminium M6 Eyebolt & Dyneema Line
parts.material: Aluminium M6 eyebolt + internal backing plate + Dyneema line
parts.dimensions: M6 threaded anchor through 4 mm printed PETG rear wall
parts.description: Purely mechanical fail-safe recovery point. Even if battery power or communications die completely inside rubble, rescuers reel SARA back out by hand.

pinMap.note: Avoided ESP32 boot pins GPIO0, 2, 12. GPIO5 and 15 are boot-strapping pins (verify at bring-up). KiCad block-level schematic passes ERC (0 errors, 0 warnings); PCB/DRC not done yet.

before: Dark gaps — no idea who is inside
A rescuer has to crawl in and look
Every gap gets the same risk and the same time
Rubble can shift while the person is inside
after: Operator sends SARA into the gap first
Live camera plus heat, CO2 and sound readings come back
AI marks useful frames; laptop shows an evidence score
Operator sends SARA back to the strongest spot to confirm
Rescuers go in knowing where to look first
userJourney.honestNote: Time saved and risk reduced will be measured on our rubble test course in Stage 3. We do not quote invented percentages.

safety.statusNote: All fail-safes below are PLANNED and UNTESTED. No IP rating (body is not sealed). Standards IEC 62133 and ISO 12100 are considered as guidance only — no certification claimed.

rows.hazard: SARA stuck or moving blind in rubble
rows.failsafe: ESP32 watchdog cuts MOTOR_EN, nose LEDs blink, operator reels SARA back with the retrieval line
Purely mechanical Dyneema retrieval line on M6 eyebolt lets rescuers reel SARA out by hand

rows.hazard: Anchor pulls out of rear shell
rows.failsafe: Aluminium M6 eyebolt with internal backing plate on 4 mm PETG wall; real pull test planned
2S BMS, 10 A inline fuse, main switch, and 2 NTC sensors read by ESP32 (cutoff set in bench tests)
TB6612FNG thermal shutdown plus timed drive commands and ramped PWM
4 steel cables per joint share the load; body can still be pulled out mechanically

physicalFailsafes: Hand-pulled Dyneema retrieval line on M6 aluminium eyebolt
2S BMS, 10 A fuse, and physical main power switch
STOP button on the operator browser dashboard

risks.detail: 8 MG90S servos can draw ~5.6 A if all stall together against a 5 A 6 V buck.
risks.backup: Firmware limits how many servos move simultaneously; swap to higher-current buck if bench tests require it.

risks.detail: 12 V-rated N20 motors running on 7.4 V produce lower speed and torque; stall current is unknown.
risks.backup: Bench test one complete belt module first in Dec 2026; upgrade to higher-torque gear ratio or higher-voltage pack if needed.

risks.detail: 12 motor PWMs, I2C, UART, MOTOR_EN, CO2 PWM, and 2 NTCs nearly exhaust GPIO.
risks.backup: 2× MCP23017 I2C I/O expanders already added for all 24 direction pins; can daisy-chain another expander if needed.

risks.detail: 4 steel tendons per joint must stay balanced or bending feels sloppy or binds.
risks.backup: Tune tensioners on the bench before rubble trials; 4 cables per joint share mechanical load.

risks.risk: Retrieval anchor on 4 mm printed PETG wall
risks.detail: Pull force passes through a 4 mm 3D-printed rear wall; strength is untested and FEA is not done yet.
risks.backup: Run FEA and a physical pull test; stronger backup ties the eyebolt directly to the last aluminium joint yoke with a steel cable.

risks.detail: USB-Ethernet cable stiffness, length, and snag resistance inside debris are not finalized.
risks.backup: Evaluate flexible tether options in Stage 3; watchdog stops motors and mechanical line recovers SARA if link drops.

risks.risk: AI false alarms in dark or dusty scenes
risks.detail: Dust clouds, warm debris, or occlusions can trigger noisy camera or thermal detections.
risks.backup: Fuse camera, thermal, CO2, and audio into one evidence score and always keep the human operator as final decision maker.

roadmap.title: Procure, Print & Machine
roadmap.tasks: Order electronics and hardware, 3D-print PETG shells and TPU belts/sleeves, machine the 8 Aluminium 6061 cardan yokes.

roadmap.title: Single-Module Bench Test
roadmap.tasks: Assemble one belt module and one cardan joint. Bench test N20 motors, MG90S servos, and cable bending. Measure real current draw.

roadmap.title: Full Integration, Firmware & FEA
roadmap.tasks: Wire all segments, write ESP32 watchdog firmware, Pi video server, operator dashboard, laptop AI detection, finalize KiCad and run FEA.

roadmap.title: Rubble Course & Pull Test
roadmap.tasks: Build a rubble test course, run the rear-anchor pull test, tune motion and evidence scoring, and rehearse the live Stage 3 demo.

stage3Target: A working, remotely controlled SARA that crawls and bends through our rubble test course, streams live video and sensor readings, and shows an evidence score on the laptop.
